method.filtering_summary: The live search pulled 2,675 postings; 1,746 were older than 7 days, 84 were reposts of listings over 30 days old, 257 were senior or excluded titles, 250 were not target roles, 163 failed Kenya eligibility, 23 were already applied to and 44 were duplicates. ReliefWeb failed in the automated search (parse error) and the automated Wellfound fetch is disabled by design. Only one role is shortlisted today because the other candidates failed on opening the posting: the two GitLab backend roles and the other We Work Remotely roles are locked to one country, ask 5+ years, require US work eligibility or East Coast hours. Browser passes (signed in, 24 Nov): Wellfound (about 95 results, 8 kept; none shortlisted because experience asked was not read and the box has no signed-in browser to re-open them, so they are listed under Dropped for a re-check), Fuzu (about 60 jobs, 2 kept) and the MyJobMag personalised feed (26 on the first page, 2 kept). Jobgether returned 510 roles and 210 fresh; none were shortlisted because the Africa-tagged ones were a copy of the Revit and computer-vision post or could not be opened, and the rest were Europe-only. micro1 returned 68 roles; the new ones include an undergraduate talent network post, a consumer-security tester and a Europe-only agent tester, so none were shortlisted.

jobs.title: Full-Stack Engineer Central Engineering
jobs.experience_asked: No years stated in the posting text (the application form has a years-of-experience question). Asks for experience shipping and operating full-stack web apps in production, more than one of Python, TypeScript and Node.js, Docker, AWS, Kubernetes and CI/CD, and MySQL in production.

jobs.gaps: Asks for production operation of Docker, AWS and Kubernetes and MySQL, and an observability and security baseline, which is more than his one year shows. He applied to Sporty Group's Applied AI Engineer (LLM) role earlier today, so a second application is his call.

stories.title: Anthropic launches Claude Ship to review, fix and approve pull requests
stories.summary: Claude Ship has three parts: Code Review (generally available) and two beta agents, PR Steward (fixes failing CI, merge conflicts and review comments) and Claude Approvals (approves routine changes under a policy file kept in the repo); it is rolling out to Claude Team and Enterprise plans for GitHub repositories.
stories.why: Agent-driven code review and approval is becoming part of normal engineering workflows, which is the kind of tooling he builds and will be asked about.

stories.title: Strands releases Decider v2, five open models that pick tools and routes for agents
stories.summary: Five Gemma 4-based models from E2B to 31B under Apache-2.0; the 31B averages 82.1 on six text benchmarks, up from 70.0 for v1 26B-A4B, and the post says an Amazon ticketing team cut cost 98% and latency 78% by using v1 instead of Claude Sonnet 4.6 for ticket labeling.
stories.why: Small open models that make routing and tool-choice decisions cheaply are a practical way to cut cost in agent projects.

stories.title: Gemini API adds file slicing so agents load only the pages or cells they need
stories.summary: Developers can pick page ranges, sheet cell ranges and media segments of PDFs, Office files, audio and video, and tokens are billed only for the parts Gemini inspects; it works across Gemini 4 models and adds native upload of Microsoft Office and OpenDocument files.
stories.why: It lowers token cost for document-heavy agents without local PDF or ffmpeg tooling in the harness.

stories.title: Sierra raises $1.75 billion at a $30 billion valuation
stories.summary: The Series F was led by Greenoaks and Lightspeed and doubles the $15 billion valuation from under six months ago; Sierra says it serves almost 50% of the Fortune 50 and has doubled run-rate revenue to $400 million in five months.
stories.why: Customer-service agents are one of the best-funded areas of agentic AI, which means more hiring for people who build and integrate them.

stories.title: Supertake raises $20M seed for AI agents that turn market views into portfolios
stories.summary: Adjacent led the round with Coinbase Ventures and USV; agents cannot deposit or withdraw without the user's consent and never see brokerage credentials, and the team plans to hire in engineering, design and growth.
stories.why: A fintech example of agents with hard guardrails and spend limits, close to his fintech work.

stories.title: Nairobi's Axmed gets $4.28M Gates Foundation grant for pharmacy procurement
stories.summary: Of the total, $2.28 million launches Axmed Retail through a Family Planning Retail Demand Pool in Kenya, pooling orders across private pharmacies, and $2 million funds family planning procurement in Nigeria.
stories.why: A Kenyan technology company funded to build procurement and supply-chain software, a possible employer for backend and integrations work.

stories.title: Report: AI is squeezing entry-level hiring more than it is causing layoffs
stories.summary: The RAISE US and Burning Glass Institute report says white-collar industries have 1.5 million fewer jobs than pre-pandemic trends implied, early-career opportunities in widely AI-using industries shrank 3-8% on average between 2021 and 2026, and office and administrative jobs fell by 780,000 from 2023 to 2025.
stories.why: It is US data, but it matches what he sees in junior postings that ask for experience, so showing shipped work matters more.

stories.title: NPR: employers pulling back from entry-level hiring where AI use is highest
stories.summary: Burning Glass Institute president Matt Sigelman says employers in industries furthest ahead in adopting AI are increasingly looking for people who already have experience, so graduates are being asked to start their careers in the middle.
stories.why: It explains why many junior listings ask for experience and why concrete projects carry weight.

stories.title: Pesalink reaches basic inclusivity level after adding till and paybill payments
stories.summary: AfricaNenda's 2026 report puts Pesalink among 31 African instant payment systems at the minimum inclusivity level; the new person-to-business service lets consumers pay through banks, Saccos or mobile money using till numbers, paybills or QR codes.
stories.why: Bank-to-merchant instant payments competing with M-PESA's till and paybill is directly relevant to Kenyan payments integrations.

stories.title: Former M-PESA chief Esther Waititu joins Visa as regional country manager
stories.summary: She led M-PESA at Safaricom from February 2023 to July 2026 and is now Visa's senior vice-president and group country manager for Southern and Eastern Africa; Business Daily says M-PESA and Airtel Money have lost four top bosses to banks and payment networks in the last year.
stories.why: Card networks, banks and mobile money are moving into each other's markets, which shapes where fintech engineering jobs will appear.

stories.title: Nigeria's Payaza gets a Central Bank of Kenya payment service provider licence
stories.summary: The licence lets Payaza offer payment gateway services in Kenya directly, following a similar designation in Zambia last month.
stories.why: Another payments company building in Kenya, so more payment-gateway and integration roles may follow.
